classification.rootCause: Runner diagnostics discarded task-probe evidence immediately after the one-hour authorization TTL. A later capability scan therefore represented an expired probe as not_run, losing the distinction between expired and never run.
classification.fix: Retain structurally valid probe outcomes for up to 30 days after expiry for diagnostics. Execution authorization still checks the original expiresAt timestamp and rejects expired evidence.
classification.deviceConsent: Independent authorization dimension; this change does not create or widen consent.
classification.capabilityAcknowledgement: Independent publication/acknowledgement dimension; this change does not mark capability as acknowledged.

assertions: Expired probe evidence remains available for diagnosis.
Expired probe evidence does not produce external-agent authorization.

runtimeAcceptance.reason: This evidence is limited to the Runner source fix and focused tests; it is not live Runner or protected DevelopmentRun acceptance.
